records.key: Choose a folder of paired multichannel fields (.npy or .tif) and the channels to learn from and to predict, for example 1 > 0 to predict the nucleus stain from channel 1. A small U-Net is trained on the CPU, the last quarter of the fields is held out, and the real and predicted stains are segmented the same way and matched at IoU 0.5. The model, predictions and a score table are written to <folder>/virtual_stain. Default 20 epochs.
records.source: Choose a folder of paired multichannel fields (.npy or .tif) and the channels to learn from and to predict, for example 1 > 0 to predict the nucleus stain from channel 1. A small U-Net is trained on the CPU, the last quarter of the fields is held out, and the real and predicted stains are segmented the same way and matched at IoU 0.5. The model, predictions and a score table are written to <folder>/virtual_stain. Default 20 epochs.
records.translation: Veldu möppu með pöruðum myndsviðum með mörgum rásum (.npy eða .tif) og rásirnar sem læra á af og spá fyrir um, til dæmis 1 > 0 til að spá fyrir um kjarnalitun út frá rás 1. Lítið U-Net er þjálfað á CPU; síðasti fjórðungur myndsviðanna er tekinn frá og ekki notaður við þjálfun. Raunveruleg og spáð litun eru hlutuð á sama hátt og samsvörun metin við IoU 0.5. Líkanið, spárnar og tafla með niðurstöðum eru skrifuð í <folder>/virtual_stain. Sjálfgefið: 20 þjálfunarlotur.

records.key: Published results: Ravi et al., 'SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos', ICLR 2025 (arXiv:2408.00714). spaCR has not scored it against those results; item 556 scores it on Cell Tracking Challenge movies.
records.source: Published results: Ravi et al., 'SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos', ICLR 2025 (arXiv:2408.00714). spaCR has not scored it against those results; item 556 scores it on Cell Tracking Challenge movies.
records.translation: Birtar niðurstöður: Ravi et al., 'SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos', ICLR 2025 (arXiv:2408.00714). spaCR hefur ekki metið líkanið gagnvart þessum niðurstöðum; liður 556 metur það á myndröðum úr Cell Tracking Challenge.

records.key: SAM2 1.1.0 is Apache-2.0 (Copyright Meta Platforms). Its SAM2.1 checkpoints, Apache-2.0 as well, are downloaded from the facebook/sam2.1-hiera-* repositories on Hugging Face into the backend's own folder the first time a movie is followed. PyPI carries SAM2 only as source, so it is built inside the environment, without its optional CUDA post-processing extension. spaCR ships none of it.
records.source: SAM2 1.1.0 is Apache-2.0 (Copyright Meta Platforms). Its SAM2.1 checkpoints, Apache-2.0 as well, are downloaded from the facebook/sam2.1-hiera-* repositories on Hugging Face into the backend's own folder the first time a movie is followed. PyPI carries SAM2 only as source, so it is built inside the environment, without its optional CUDA post-processing extension. spaCR ships none of it.
records.translation: SAM2 1.1.0 er með Apache-2.0 leyfi (Copyright Meta Platforms). Vistuðu SAM2.1-líkanastöður þess eru einnig undir Apache-2.0 og eru sóttar úr facebook/sam2.1-hiera-* gagnageymslunum á Hugging Face í eigin möppu bakendans þegar fyrst er rakið í gegnum myndröð. PyPI býður SAM2 aðeins sem frumkóða, þannig að það er byggt innan umhverfisins án valfrjálsrar CUDA-viðbótar fyrir eftirvinnslu. spaCR dreifir engum þessara hluta.

records.key: SAM2's video predictor, as a timelapse mode: seeded with spaCR's masks on the first frame, it follows each object through the movie with a memory of its appearance, so segmentation and tracking are one step and every object keeps its id. Objects that appear later are seeded where spaCR first finds them.
records.source: SAM2's video predictor, as a timelapse mode: seeded with spaCR's masks on the first frame, it follows each object through the movie with a memory of its appearance, so segmentation and tracking are one step and every object keeps its id. Objects that appear later are seeded where spaCR first finds them.
records.translation: Myndskeiðaspálíkan SAM2 sem hamur fyrir tímaraðir: það byrjar með grímum spaCR í fyrsta ramma og fylgir hverjum hlut í gegnum myndröðina með minni um útlit hans. Þannig verða hlutun og rakning eitt skref og hver hlutur heldur auðkenni sínu. Hlutir sem birtast síðar eru frumstilltir þar sem spaCR finnur þá fyrst.

records.key: Virtual stain on {fields} held-out fields: F1 {f1:.2f} at IoU 0.5 against the real stain's objects (input channel alone {base:.2f}), Pearson r {r:.2f}.
